label: Maryland x Personal Injury
source: Opened for Malloy Law Offices, whose Baltimore office at 400 E Pratt St is one of eight verified locations, and filled out with eight more Maryland firms. The Ahrefs figures on every entry are zeros standing in for measurements we have not taken, not measurements of zero: no Maryland profile carries a digital.ahrefs block, so D2 is pending on all of them and these peer values are never read. They exist because the percentile helper needs the keys present. Replace them before trusting a single D2 score in this cohort. Deepened 2026-09-14: candidates from Google Places text search across the metro (scripts/discover_places.py), each kept only where the firm's own site publishes a personal injury practice page (scripts/check_practice.py) and it holds an office in the 21 postal area (scripts/vet_candidates.py). The firms added on this pass carry no Ahrefs metrics, so D2 scores pending for them.

licence_register: None queryable. The Maryland Judiciary publishes an attorney listing at mdcourts.gov/attysearch, but mdcourts.gov/robots.txt carries Disallow: /attysearch, so we do not query it and Maryland profiles carry no licence finding rather than one we did not make. Checked 2026-09-10. New York publishes the equivalent register as open data, which is why G1 and G2 exist on New York profiles and are absent here.
entity_register: None queryable. Maryland business filings sit behind egov.maryland.gov, which serves Disallow: / to every crawler. G3 and G6 are therefore absent on Maryland profiles.

unresolved_notes.forthepeople.com: Excluded from every cohort. Morgan & Morgan holds an office in this market and in roughly a thousand others, and a profile on this site asserts one home market: market.city, market.state, one city page, one ranked list. For a national chain that assertion is false everywhere except wherever we happened to file it, and the firm turned up in the Baltimore and Lakeland candidate lists at once, which is how the conflict surfaced. The rule is about the data model rather than about size: a firm we cannot place in one market is a firm this directory cannot describe.
